chapter.name: de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog pa ste dang po
dpal rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu sbyor ba'i rtog pa ste gnyis pa
lha mo thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba skal pa mchog bzang po dpal rdo rje dam tshig gi rtog pa ste gsum pa
dpal dam tshig gi rtog pa ste bzhi pa
gtam gyi phyag rgya zhes pa rtog pa ste lnga pa
sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtog pa ste drug pa
kun tu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rtog pa ste dgu pa
kun tu sna tshogs skal ba bzang po dam tshig gi rtog pa ste le'u bcu pa

item.coloph: rnam mas rjes chags dga' ba'i pad+mo rnam dag mchod pa dang// rta mchog rnalyor 'debs gsal bar rjesu mchod na ni/ rab tu bde ba'i rnalyor dam pa skal bzangs dga' ba'i mchog/ rab mchog bde ba'i rang bzhin bde ba rjesu 'grub par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdoe seMda' de skad ces gsungso // sangs rgyas thaMd mnyam sbyor ba// mkha'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog/ ces pa'i/ rtog pathaMd kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya ba'i bde ba chen po'i sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rdzogs+ho // //rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal sangs rgyas thaMd dang mnyam par sbyor ba// mkha'gro sgyu ma bde /mchog las// bde ba chen po phyag rgya'i rgyud ces bya ba' rdzogso // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra ha sya dang/ sgyu 'phrul gyi lo ts+tsha ba rma rin chen mchog gis 'brel pa bzhi'i gzhung dang bstun te zhu chen dang bcas par gtan la phab pa'o

chapter.name: sangs rgyas thaMd mnyam sbyor ba// mkha'gro sgyu ma bde mchog las// de kho na nyid dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i// ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog pa ste dang pa
sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam sbyor ba// mkha'gro ma'i bde mchog las// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu sbyor ba rtog pa de gnyis pa

sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba// mkha'gro sgyu ma bde mchog las// sna tshogs thaMd kyi skal pa bzang po mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste// dpal dam tshig gi rtog pa ste bzhi pa
sangyas thaMd mnyam par sbyor ba// mkha'gro sgyu ma bde mchog las//gtaM gyi phyag rgya shes pa'i rtog pa ste lnga pa
